The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `8500` (see `ConsulBuilder.ConsulHttpPort`)
- Port: `8502` (see `ConsulBuilder.ConsulGrpcPort`)
- Command: `agent -dev -client 0.0.0.0`
- Create parameter: `HostConfig.CapAdd=["IPC_LOCK"]`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /v1/status/leader` to port `8500` is completed successfully.
